pages.title: Strike! · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Friday night at a loud bowling alley in Dallas. Pins crash and people cheer in every lane. Gabi arrives with three friends and big smiles. They have never played together before. At the counter, a man named Sid waits. Colorful lights shine behind him.
“Welcome to Strike Lanes! How many players?” says Sid. “Four players, please.” says Gabi. “Great. For how long? One hour or two?” says Sid.

pages.title: Strike! · 3/3
paragraphs: “Okay. Can we order pizza and drinks?” says Gabi. “Sure. A waiter will come to your lane. Have fun!” says Sid. Gabi pays sixty dollars for lane six. The friends change into the rental shoes. They choose balls of different colors and weights. Gabi throws the first ball and gets a strike! A waiter brings pizza and cold drinks. Friends, laughs and pins make a perfect night.
